caption:
Mid-June in Texas means the summer run is already well underway.

Trailers have been rolling. Horses have been competing. And most of them have never had anyone put hands on their spine to ask how they're holding up.

A maintenance check with Dr. Leo isn't about fixing a broke horse. It's about keeping a sound horse from becoming one — before the back half of summer gets here.

Dr. Leo is a cAVCA-certified equine chiropractor serving DFW and North Texas. He comes to your barn. You don't haul a sore horse anywhere.

Book now — shortgochiro.com or (406) 799-3369.
